clauses.text:
Executive Order 10971
CREATING AN EMERGENCY BOARD  
TO INVESTIGATE A DISPUTE BE­
TWEEN TRANS WORLD AIRLINES,  
INC., AND CERTAIN OF ITS EM­
PLOYEES
WHEREAS a dispute exists between 
Trans World Airlines, Inc., a carrier, 
and certain of its employees represented 
by the Air Line Pilots Association, In­
ternational, a labor organization; and 
WHEREAS this dispute has not here­
tofore been adjusted under the pro­
visions of the Railway Labor Act, as 
amended; and
WHEREAS this dispute, in the judg­
ment of the National Mediation Board, 
threatens substantially to interrupt in­
terstate commerce to a degree such as 
to deprive a section of the country of 
essential transportation service:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by section 10 of 
the Railway Labor Act, as amended (45 
TJJS.C . 160), I  hereby create a board of 
three members, to be appointed by me, 
to investigate this dispute. No member 
of the board shall be pecuniarily or 
otherwise interested in any organization 
of employees or any carrier.
The board shall report its findings to 
the President with respect to this dispute 
within thirty days from the date of this 
order.
As provided by section 10 of the Rail­
way Labor Act, as amended, from this 
date and for thirty days after the board 
has made its report to the President, no 
change, except by agreement, shall be 
made by Trans World Airlines, Inc., or 
by its employees, in the conditions out 
of which the dispute arose.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 10971 is a Railway Labor Act section 10 emergency-board order with provisional status no. I read the held registered Federal Register text, confirmed the order’s identity from its heading and number, and confirmed a single-clause inventory. It has no own-terms end. The only held instrument that revokes it is EO 12553 (1986-02-25), which I read; the report date and the end of the status-quo period are disclosed spent facts, not ends. The searches chosen (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) carry no coverage warning and show no hit for this order that contradicts the ending.

The order’s own terms contain only the report direction and the status-quo period, which are report-relative deadlines and not ends. The Cruden number lookup in LOOKUPS.md finds this number cited only in the order’s own held texts, in the NMB report text where one is held, and in EO 12553. No held later order other than EO 12553 revokes, supersedes, amends or terminates it, and no statute held in the packet does so; an unnamed statute or order would in any case not end it (owner ruling 2026-10-21 unnamed instruments). The dossier’s conflicts and missing lists are empty or concern only a number citation without a change provision (no held text gives the actual report date).","independent_command_check":"No independent command survives: the board’s creation was performed when the order issued; the report direction and the status-quo period are time-limited by the order itself and by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act; the order creates no standing office, delegation, rule or continuing duty that would outlast the report and the thirty-day period.
